assembly_notes: Install and secure the PCBA and wiring before joining the shells; verify mating faces and boss pilots are free of debris.
Use controlled screw-driving torque to avoid stripping plastic bosses, and confirm the shell seam is uniformly closed.
Perform flight-controller, ESC, motor, camera/gimbal, Wi-Fi, and power-system functional tests, followed by a documented burn-in.
Protect battery leads against short circuits, prevent accidental activation, and ship LiPo cells by sea only as UN3481 packed with equipment.
